name: Sasaki Ryou
source: His parents died three years prior to the story, causing him to live alone with [url=https://vndb.org/c4696]his older step-sister[/url], who is now his caretaker. Often scares others away with his sharp glares and antisocial demeanor. Is also quick to anger and has a foul mouth. Beneath the rough exterior lies a soft and kind personality, willing to do anything to help his friends.
